sources.title: Verbale di accordo ANEC, FISTel-CISL, UILCOM-UIL del 12 febbraio 2026, rivalutazione dei minimi tabellari (IPCA)

notes.text: Primary source: CCNL Esercizi Cinematografici 2023-2026 (FISTel CISL, signed 16/10/2025). Art. 54: period 01/01/2023-31/12/2026. Three salary tranches: 01/01/2023, 01/11/2024, 01/07/2025 from salary tables (pages 59-65 of the PDF). Baseline (31/12/2022 column) used only for increment verification, not modelled as a separate period.
Hourly divisor 173: Art. 63 Dichiarazione a verbale (explicit formula: 'la retribuzione oraria si ottiene dividendo quella mensile per il coefficiente 173'). Daily divisor 26 also from Art. 63.
Additional months 14: Art. 20 (tredicesima, December) and Art. 21 (quattordicesima, paid 1 luglio each year).

Seniority (Art. 22): biennale (cadence 24 months), maximum 5 scatti. Amounts from Tabella A (appended to CCNL). Cross-verified against Art. 62 (Indennita di Cassa 'Sola P.B.' table): Tabella A formula is 5% of frozen paga base (Art. 62 column) plus a fixed addend (3.62 for monosala L3, confirming 12.72+3.62=16.34). The salary table bottom row shows 16.26 for monosala L3 (IV scatto basis) — this is a typographic error; Tabella A value 16.34 is authoritative.

Apprenticeship (Art. 16): percentage type, 70%/80%/90% for years 1/2/3 of the apprenticeship, calculated on the minimo salariale of the classification level. In vigore dal 01/01/2018. Applicable to all 15 levels (Art. 16 states no level exclusion).

Two parallel level systems in the same contract (one CNEL code G211): Monosala/Multisala (7 levels: 1,2,3,4,5,5S,Q with parametri 100/112/132/159/176/185/220) and Multiplex/Megaplex (8 levels: A,B,C,D,E,F,QB,QA with parametri 100/122/140/150/165/185/220/240). The 15 levels are interleaved by salary for ordering (non-decreasing constraint). Levels 1 and A share identical salaries (parametro 100), as do 5S and F (parametro 185) and Q and QB (parametro 220). Level QA (parametro 240) is Multiplex/Megaplex only. The 'order' field is a global salary rank across both classification scales and is not a promotion ladder.
Level code aliases in the PDF: monosala Q is also written 'VI Qua' in the paga table header and '6' in Tabella B. Code 'Q' (Tabella A label) is used consistently here.

SIMPLIFICATION: tax_sector=TERZIARIO. Cinema exhibition employees (esercizio cinematografico) were historically under ENPALS (now FPLS — Fondo Pensione Lavoratori dello Spettacolo dell'INPS, Art. 12 comma 6 of this CCNL). The FPLS contribution regime differs from ordinary terziario. terziario rates are used as an approximation pending a dedicated cinema-FPLS tax file. For the workers enrolled after 31 December 1995 the IVS of the FPLS is the ordinary 33% (23.81 + 9.19) up to the annual massimale (INPS, Calcolo dei contributi IVS dei lavoratori dello spettacolo, updated 5 October 2026), as charged here; approximated are the daily bands of the workers enrolled before 1996 (massimale 892 a day in 2026, solidarity 5% above it) and the non-IVS contributions.

limitation.remediation: Add a dedicated FPLS contribution ruleset for cinema exhibition employees.

notes.text: SICKNESS INPS REGIME: the employees insured with the Fondo pensioni lavoratori dello spettacolo, operai and impiegati alike, have their own INPS sickness indemnity (INPS circ. 132/2021): from the fourth day, 60% up to the 20th day and 80% from the 21st to the 180th (regime 'spettacolo'), with 40 daily contributions from 1 January of the year before (SicknessEpisode.daily_contributions).

SICKNESS (Art. 64): the CCNL integrates up to 100% of the normal net pay ('normale retribuzione netta') without saying how the net pay is computed. The engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate (the 'lordizzazione' of payroll practice, Ordine dei Consulenti del Lavoro di Salerno) and tops it up to the measure of the gross daily quota; IRPEF is left out, as it falls on both. Day bands, carenza by event, the yearly comporto and the exclusion of apprentices are modelled.

limitation.remediation: Find a source (an interpretation of the parties, an INPS or Ministry text) that defines the net daily pay of Art. 64, align the computation, then resolve this limitation.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY (Art. 16, p. 25 of the CCNL 2023-2026): the seniority for the aumenti periodici runs from the conversion of the apprenticeship; no increment during it (seniority_increments.apprentice_amount 0.00).

Art. 61: national weekday holidays and the stated weekday patron saint day during sickness, injury and compulsory maternity have a full daily-pay target. Easter Sunday and other Sunday holidays are not calculated by the weekday-only absence holiday mechanisms; optional leave and other absence treatments are not modelled.

limitation.remediation: Support Sunday holidays including Easter Sunday during insured absences and the remaining absence treatments. A local patron saint date must be supplied by the employer.

notes.text: SICKNESS (Art. 64): stated hospital stays, including day hospital, are excluded from the comporto and pay counts. Life-saving therapies, recurring certified treatments and continuous absences exceeding a month due to serious illness (up to 90 days) are not excluded. From day 181 the CCNL pays 50% of its own integration, but the engine reads this as 50% of pay: a day INPS still indemnifies in a new year is paid only the INPS share.

limitation.remediation: Exclude documented life-saving therapies, certified recurring treatments and qualifying continuous serious-illness absences from both counts; obtain hospital-stay facts when unstated, and pay half of the employer integration after day 180.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 20 - Tredicesima mensilita' o gratifica natalizia (p. 27): "La frazione di mese superiore a 15 giorni sarà considerata, a tali effetti, come mese intero.". Match: more_than 15.

reviews.scope: Verbale of 12 February 2026: the IPCA adjustment of the minimi from January 2026 (pp. 1-3).
findings: The minimi rise 1.7% from January 2026 (26.58 EUR at level IV, reparametrised); the seniority amounts are unchanged.

reviews.scope: The monthly values of the levels against the primary tables (text layer).
findings: 60 values found verbatim on the cited pages and marked verified; 0 left as they were (derived or not on a text page).

reviews.scope: Art. 61, cached PDF pp. 46-47, national weekday holidays and sickness paragraph.
findings: Art. 61 tops up sickness treatment to full daily pay on national weekday holidays; injury, maternity, Easter Sunday and the patron saint remain unmodelled.

reviews.scope: Holiday pay during work injury, including the applicable holiday calendar and the offset against statutory and contractual daily pay.
findings: Covered weekday holiday target reaches full daily pay after INAIL and ordinary CCNL integration; employer-specific holidays remain outside the national calendar.

reviews.scope: Local patron saint day in sickness and work injury holiday clauses.
findings: Art. 61 - Festività, sickness paragraph (p. 47): In caso di assenza dovuta a malattia, infortunio, gravidanza e puerperio, nei giorni festivi innanzi elencati l'azienda integrerà il trattamento economico corrisposto dagli istituti assistenziali ed assicurativi fino a raggiungere l'intera retribuzione giornaliera prevista dal 2° comma del presente articolo. The stated local patron saint day is covered when the target opts in; unstated days leave other holidays unchanged.

reviews.scope: Art. 61 pregnancy and puerperium holiday daily-pay target against the cached agreement PDF.
findings: Art. 61, PDF p. 47: pregnancy and puerperium holiday pay is integrated to the full daily pay. The list includes Easter Sunday and the local patron saint, but the current absence holiday mechanisms skip Sundays.

reviews.scope: Art. 64 hospital exclusions, printed p. 50 of the cached primary contract.
findings: Art. 64 excludes hospital stays including day hospital from both the job-protection and pay counts; therapies and qualifying serious-illness absences are additional exclusions not represented by hospital stays.

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.

employer_funds.description: Byblos - Fondo nazionale pensione complementare per i lavoratori delle aziende della carta, grafiche ed editoriali

location.quote: Le parti individuano nel Fondo Byblos il fondo di previdenza complementare per le aziende del settore. [...] L'adesione volontaria del lavoratore, al Fondo Byblos, comporterà una contribuzione percentuale mensile per 12 mensilità annue a carico delle aziende ed una contribuzione percentuale mensile per 12 mensilità annue a carico del lavoratore dell'1% della retribuzione contrattuale

provenance.transformation: 1% employer and 1% worker of the retribuzione contrattuale on each of the 12 monthly payments: the TFR base of the engine on a regular run, which on this CCNL (no allowance on any level) holds the minimum and the scatti; none on the tredicesima and quattordicesima runs (extra_months false).
provenance.note: Read from the PDF the url serves (sha256 3bf774ddda3db69a37228fb7fb02ae6f451fe89a26ce64de78c771400185c382, the ruleset records an earlier hash of the same url), text layer. Art. ferie — 28 giorni di calendario (24 lavorativi)

location.quote: In caso di assenza dovuta a malattia, infortunio, gravidanza e puerperio, nei giorni festivi innanzi elencati l'azienda integrerà il trattamento economico corrisposto dagli istituti assistenziali ed assicurativi fino a raggiungere l'intera retribuzione giornaliera prevista dal 2° comma del presente articolo.

provenance.transformation: On a national weekday holiday within the sickness comporto, top up the daily treatment to 100% after crediting the institutional sickness indemnity. Injury, maternity and Easter Sunday are not calculated by this sickness rule; the stated local patron saint day is covered on weekdays. The national calendar adds 4 October from 2026 (L. 151/2025), which this text, signed before, does not list: excluded (excluded_days 10-04).

location.section: Art. 64 - TRATTAMENTO DI MALATTIA ED INFORTUNIO NON SUL LAVORO
location.quote: Nel computo del limite della conservazione del posto e del trattamento economico come sopra definiti non saranno conteggiate: - le assenze dovute a ricovero ospedaliero, compreso il day hospital; - le terapie salvavita; - i periodi di assenza continuativa superiori ad un mese dovuti a gravi patologie, entro il limite complessivo di 90 giorni.

provenance.transformation: Exclude stated hospital-stay days, including day hospital, from both the rolling pay count and the comporto count. The existing 36-month window, pay bands and 365-day limit remain; 50% of employer integration after day 180, qualifying therapies and serious illness absences remain approximated or unmodelled.

location.section: Art. 48, Preavviso, lettere A e B
location.quote: I1 rapporto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato non potrà essere risolto da nessuna delle parti senza un preavviso i cui termini sono stabiliti come segue: A) Preavviso Impiegati […] Fino a 5 anni 2 Mesi 1 mese 15 giorni calendario; oltre 5 fino a 10 anni 3 Mesi 45 giorni calendario 30 giorni calendario; oltre 10 anni 4 Mesi 2 mesi 45 giorni calendario. B) Preavviso operai Livello 1° Mono Multisala - Livello A multiplex = 15 giorni calendario. I termini di disdetta decorrono dalla metà e dalla fine di ciascun mese.

provenance.transformation: Bands proposed by a delegated search and checked band by band against the PDF by a separate session: quadri and impiegati by level and service, the operai of levels 1 and A 15 calendar days, for either cause, from the middle or the end of each month. The text does not state the rateo of the extra months or the TFR treatment of the indemnity.

location.quote: In caso di assenza dovuta a malattia, infortunio, gravidanza e puerperio, nei giorni festivi innanzi elencati l'azienda integrerà il trattamento economico corrisposto dagli istituti assistenziali ed assicurativi fino a raggiungere l'intera retribuzione giornaliera prevista dal 2° comma del presente articolo.

provenance.transformation: The maternity rule has only a holiday target, not an ordinary maternity integration. Pregnancy and puerperium holidays reach full daily pay after the INPS share; weekday national holidays and the stated local patron saint day are covered. Exclude 4 October, absent from the contract's holiday list. Sunday holidays including Easter Sunday cannot be calculated by this weekday-only mechanism.
